name: PHASES
fullName: Development of the PHASES Score for Prediction of Risk of Rupture of Intracranial Aneurysms
population: n=8382, adults across six prospective cohorts, NIHSS incidental unruptured saccular aneurysms, 29,166 person-years of follow-up
teachingPoint: PHASES gives an absolute 5-year rupture risk for incidental aneurysms, anchoring treat-versus-observe discussions.
